title: Changes to an Issued Mortgage Pre-Approval
content:
Lowering the maximum purchase price of a Mortgage Pre-Approval is always allowed. Raising it, changing the named agent and a material change found on review are governed by Larkspur Home Lending's credit policy as follows.

## Policy

1. Lowering the maximum purchase price is always allowed.
2. Raising it by more than the level's largest raise allowed without re-running the approval, in percent, or at all where the level requires the approval to be re-run for a raise, re-runs the issuance checks on current information.
3. Naming or changing the agent and granting or revoking the agent sharing authorization is the borrower's decision alone; an agent cannot add themselves.
4. A credit score drop of the level's material-change credit score fall, in points, or more, new debt or an employment change found on review voids an underwritten pre-approval. A pre-approval voided on review shows the status declined.

A terms update on an issued pre-approval records a change to its maximum loan amount, its maximum purchase price, the planned down payment, the named agent or the agent sharing authorization.

## Raising the maximum purchase price

| Level setting | Size of the raise | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| The level requires the approval to be re-run for a raise | any raise | the issuance checks are re-run on current information |
| The level does not require the approval to be re-run for a raise | up to and including the largest raise allowed without re-running the approval | allowed without re-running the approval |
| The level does not require the approval to be re-run for a raise | more than that largest raise | the issuance checks are re-run on current information |

Hypothetical case: a maximum purchase price of USD 400,000 at a level whose largest raise without re-running the approval were 5.00 percent and which does not require the approval to be re-run for a raise. A raise to USD 420,000 is a raise of 5.00 percent, which is not more than the largest raise, so the approval is not re-run. A raise to USD 421,000 is a raise of 5.25 percent, which is more than the largest raise, so the issuance checks are re-run on current information. At a level requiring a re-run for any raise, a raise to USD 401,000 is enough to re-run them.

## Material change on review

| Found on review of an underwritten pre-approval | Effect |
|---|---|
| Credit score drop equal to or greater than the level's material-change fall | voids the pre-approval |
| New debt | voids the pre-approval |
| An employment change | voids the pre-approval |

Hypothetical case, with a material-change fall of 20 points: a score of 720 at issue and 700 on review is a drop of 20 points, which meets the fall and voids the underwritten pre-approval. A score of 701 on review is a drop of 19 points, which does not meet the fall; the score drop alone then does not void it.

## The named agent

Whether an agent is named on the pre-approval, which agent it is, and whether the borrower's sharing authorization is granted or revoked are the borrower's decision alone. An agent cannot add themselves to the pre-approval.
